text: oh ok. can u make arcade games / slots / water fountains lounge chairs, swingset (physics opportunity) sand castle, picket fence, you can make apple trees that drop apples, that act like balls and maybe we can turn it into a throwable item later or eat it. clothing racks, dispensary props liquor store props fast food props
resolution: 20 new kinds on two new palette shelves. PARK: plaza fountain (you can sit on the rim), drinking fountain, lounge chair (lay), swing set with two sittable swings, sand castle, white picket fence, apple tree with red apples in the canopy, and 'apple' as its own kickable prop that acts like a ball (bounces, rolls, lands on heightfields) — throwable/eatable is queued behind the item system as the user suggested, and actual swing PENDULUM physics is queued behind constrained bodies (today's bodies are free spheres). SHOPS: arcade cabinet (screen takes any image), slot machine (locked valuables container with a lever), clothing rack, glass display case, liquor shelf with bottle rows, beer cases, diner booth (seats 2), order counter, menu board (face takes an image — the menu), soda machine (front takes an image), neon OPEN sign, dispensary green cross. All ONE-recipe data models; both /test and the compiled game render them automatically; zero Zig changes. Suites 14/14, 3/3, 3/3, 7/7 green.
